subject.title: fix(browser): snapshots fail when managed proxy is enabled

question: Should OpenClaw permit a temporary exact managed-proxy bypass for the validated CDP discovery and WebSocket endpoints used by Playwright attachment, so managed loopback Chrome works under `proxy.enabled`?
rationale: This is a deliberate security and network-routing contract: the patch resolves the reported regression, but only maintainers can decide whether the scoped bypass is the intended long-term boundary for local managed Chrome and remote CDP configurations.

options.title: Accept the scoped bypass model
options.body: Approve the validated discovery-and-WebSocket lease model, refresh the branch against current main, and land after required checks pass.

options.title: Retain the prior proxy boundary
options.body: Do not add the Playwright bypass and keep the current failure mode until a different managed-proxy architecture is selected.

options.title: Require a narrower policy contract
options.body: Pause for an owner-defined restriction such as an explicitly managed-loopback-only admission rule before merging.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped bypass model
recommendation.body: Approve the validated discovery-and-WebSocket lease model, refresh the branch against current main, and land after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This requires repository-level acceptance of a browser proxy and SSRF security boundary rather than contributor follow-up.
